title: Order of Objects · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Order of Objects · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Place three objects in a row, let everyone look, then cover them. The lead names the objects from left to right. All three objects are named in their original order. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Three household objects and a cloth.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Order of Objects, what counts as a successful turn?
options: All three objects are named in their original order.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: All three objects are named in their original order.

game.materials: Three household objects and a cloth
